requirement.description: Multiple test failures related to async iteration protocol implementation in simulator commands. Tests fail due to missing or incorrect __aiter__ and __anext__ methods in Delay, Tick, and other command classes.
requirement.contract: Fix the async iteration protocol implementation in simulator command classes (Delay, Tick, NegEdgeTrigger) to properly support 'async for' loops and 'await' expressions. These classes must implement __aiter__ and __anext__ methods that return appropriate async iterators.

requirement.description: Test failures due to missing 'BrokenTrigger' name reference in simulator regression tests.
requirement.contract: Implement or fix the BrokenTrigger class or remove the dependency on it in test cases. Ensure all referenced classes and variables in test cases are properly defined.

requirement.description: Test failures due to incorrect handling of Amaranth value conversion to Python boolean in testbench processes.
requirement.contract: Ensure that Amaranth values are properly handled in testbench contexts and that attempts to convert them to Python booleans raise appropriate exceptions rather than silently converting.

requirement.description: Test failures due to pickle errors when serializing module objects in CRC tests.
requirement.contract: Fix serialization issues in CRC-related test cases by ensuring that module objects are not attempted to be pickled. This may involve updating how test processes are implemented or how objects are passed between processes.

requirement.description: Domain lookup test failure due to object identity comparison in ClockDomain.__eq__ method.
requirement.contract: Fix the ClockDomain.__eq__ method to correctly compare ClockDomain instances by their properties rather than reference equality. The comparison should be based on domain name, clock edge, async_reset, and local attributes.
